endorsements.quote: Training programmes should address not only the technical aspects of using digital solutions but also focus on workflow integration, best practices, and ensuring that providers understand the clinical context and significance of GDMT prescription rates.

unlisted_practices: Design digital solutions for optimizing guideline-directed medical therapy to balance alert frequency so that clinicians do not experience alert fatigue.
Make digital solutions available to and designed for groups with limited use of digital technology, such as older people and those with lower educational attainment and income.
Conduct dedicated outcome studies with clinically relevant endpoints to assess the impact of digital solutions on guideline-directed medical therapy prescription and patient outcomes.
Obtain informed consent from patients for digital solutions that collect, store, and transmit sensitive patient data.
Use multifaceted digital interventions that combine digital and non-digital components rather than standalone digital tools.
Adopt universal interoperability standards and seamless data exchange between EHR systems and digital solutions.
Follow DECIDE-AI recommendations when evaluating AI-based clinical decision support in early clinical studies.

screen.reason: This is a clinical consensus statement and expert guideline document providing recommendations on digital health solutions and AI implementation in heart failure care.
